tools.name: kassa_list_articles
tools.description: List the articles (products and services) of the cash register, with price, VAT percent, unit and bar codes. Full-text search with query, or filter by article number, bar code or your own article id. GET /api/v1/articles.

tools.name: kassa_list_article_categories
tools.description: List the product categories an article belongs to (id, name, colour). GET /api/v1/articles/{id}/product_categories.

tools.name: kassa_list_customers
tools.description: List customers, with name, customer number, address, phone and email. Full-text search with query, or filter by a field. GET /api/v1/customers.

tools.name: kassa_find_customer_by_number
tools.description: Find one customer by the customer number you assigned. GET /api/v1/customers/customer_number.

tools.name: kassa_list_warehouses
tools.description: List the warehouses (stock locations) of the company, with id and description. GET /api/v1/warehouses.

tools.name: kassa_list_inventories
tools.description: List the inventory records of a warehouse for given articles, optionally with the current stock. Rate limited by KASSA.AT. Give article_numbers (up to 1000), article_number or article. POST /api/v1/warehouses/{id}/inventories/search (a read).

tools.name: kassa_get_inventory_stock
tools.description: Get the current stock quantity of one inventory record. GET /api/v1/warehouses/{id}/inventories/{inventory_id}/stock.

tools.name: kassa_create_article
tools.description: Create a new article (product or service) in the cash register. The VAT percent must be 0, 10, 13 or 20. Creates a record; it does not delete anything. POST /api/v1/articles.

tools.name: kassa_update_article
tools.description: Change one or more fields of an article. Only the fields you pass change; the rest stay as they are. PATCH /api/v1/articles/{id}.

tools.name: kassa_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer record. Give at least one field. Creates a record; it does not delete anything. POST /api/v1/customers.

tools.name: kassa_update_customer
tools.description: Change one or more fields of a customer. Only the fields you pass change. This tool does not delete customers. PATCH /api/v1/customers/{id}.

tools.name: kassa_record_stock_movement
tools.description: Add a stock movement to one inventory: a positive quantity adds stock, a negative one removes it. It changes the stock level; it does not set an absolute level. POST /api/v1/warehouses/{id}/inventories/{inventory_id}/movements.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kassa_list_customers, kassa_list_inventories · Private data: kassa_list_inventories, kassa_get_inventory_stock, kassa_create_article, kassa_create_customer, kassa_record_stock_movement · Public sink: kassa_list_customers, kassa_list_inventories, kassa_create_article, kassa_create_customer, kassa_record_stock_movement · Destructive: kassa_create_article, kassa_create_customer, kassa_update_customer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kassa_list_customers, kassa_list_inventories · Private data: kassa_list_inventories, kassa_get_inventory_stock, kassa_create_article, kassa_create_customer, kassa_record_stock_movement · Public sink: kassa_list_customers, kassa_list_inventories, kassa_create_article, kassa_create_customer, kassa_record_stock_movement · Destructive: kassa_create_article, kassa_create_customer, kassa_update_customer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
